evidenceBoundary: This single receipt-bound Codex session records text-grounded unboxing, lossless source-chunk reading across every Default Game document, cross-document synthesis, questions and source-grounded answers, one full four-seat game, and postgame reconstruction. It is LLM simulation evidence only; it cannot establish human setup, teachability, duration, physical handling, balance, or complexity weight. Provider calls are serialized, and provider latency is not human session time.
